# metacortex.engineer

> Dr Alexander Mikhalev - Managing Partner, CTO and Head of AI, Zestic AI

## About

I combine technology direction with hands-on Rust, Python and TypeScript engineering. I lead the Terraphim AI privacy-preserving ecosystem and autonomous delivery infrastructure, alongside client architecture at Zestic AI. I am the author of Context Engineering: Designing AI That Understands, Remembers, Acts and Learns (2026).

## Core Projects

- **Terraphim AI** (https://terraphim.ai) - Privacy-preserving AI ecosystem built in Rust and WebAssembly, connecting local-first knowledge graphs, shared agent context, editor workflows, command-line tools and MCP integration. Inspectable graph embeddings combine curated concepts, synonym mappings and graph co-occurrence.
- **terraphim.rs** (https://terraphim.rs) - Technical documentation site for the Rust engine and bindings behind Terraphim AI: knowledge-graph engine, deterministic matching, WebAssembly bindings and install paths.
- **Terraphim Forge** (https://terraphim-forge.com) - Cloud code forge built for AI agents, where they triage, coordinate and execute work. PageRank issue prioritisation, an MCP server for agent coordination and a Robot API, on isolated development environments.
- **terraphim-skills.md** (https://terraphim-skills.md) - Public catalogue for discovering, installing and publishing skills for AI coding agents, with the anonymous Skills MCP endpoint.
- **Autonomous Delivery Factory** - AI Dark Factory connecting prioritised issues and agent execution with separate review, verification and validation gates. Human owners retain control of acceptance and merge.
- **Digital Synthetic Twins** - Rust platform of high-fidelity mocks of third-party APIs for offline development, deterministic tests and cost-free experimentation. Drop-in compatible with official SDKs.
- **The Pattern** (https://github.com/applied-knowledge-systems/the-pattern) - Machine Learning NLP pipeline for knowledge discovery using the Redis ecosystem, with VR/AR interfaces.
- **Blockchain-Inspired Distributed System** - Distributed system prototype resulting in a granted UK patent.
- **Terraphim AgentForge** (https://git.terraphim.cloud) - Gitea-based development platform extended with scoped agent identity, signed audit events, a unified event stream and branch-based collaboration.
- **Terraphim Skills** (https://github.com/terraphim/terraphim-skills) - The signed skill packages and CLI, installable with one command. The catalogue that serves them is terraphim-skills.md.
- **Time Agent** (https://github.com/terraphim/time-agent) - AI-native time tracking via CLI. Rust core with Cloudflare Workers API, Tauri desktop app and MCP server.

This list matches the project cards on the home page. Machine-readable copy: https://metacortex.engineer/projects.json

## Book

- **Context Engineering: Designing AI That Understands, Remembers, Acts and Learns** (2026) - A book on the discipline behind AI software that works: domain modelling, knowledge-graph grounding, deliberate context budgets, reviewable agent memory, evaluation and governance. Release candidate v1.0.0-rc1, updated 17 October 2026.

This site is built with Astro 5.x, deployed on Cloudflare R2 via a Worker router. No frameworks, vanilla CSS only.
